info.name: Certify API Layer Form Submissions API

params.name: createFacility
params.description: When true, creates a facility; response includes certifyId and facilityCreated in addition to form submission data.

params.name: createPractitioner
params.description: When true, creates a practitioner from data.practitionerData and a portal crosswalk; response includes certifyId and providerCreated in addition to form submission data.

items.docs: Creates a new form submission. When createPractitioner is true, also creates or links a practitioner (using data.practitionerData) and a portal crosswalk; returns the form submission response with certifyId and providerCreated. Form submission is created first; on failure the request fails without creating a practitioner.

info.name: Get a form submission by ID

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the form submission (UUID)

items.docs: Retrieves a single form submission by its unique ID. The response includes organizationId (from tenant), flattened data fields, and standard form submission metadata. Requires tenant-id header and valid JWT.

Creates a canonical form submission and fans out practitioner/facility crosswalk creation to multiple tenants in parallel. Returns per-tenant results with an aggregated status of success, partial_success, or failed. GCS document uploads are dispatched as Cloud Tasks asynchronously.
